```{r}
library(PatchR)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(gridExtra)
library(here)
```

```{r}

# Input/output folders
data_dir <- here("Physiology", "datfiles")
save_dir <- here("Physiology", "Physiology Script", "validation")

dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Recording file
data_file <- file.path(
  data_dir,
  "276_2026-03-25_001.dat"
)

# PatchMaster location
experiment_number <- 3
series_number <- 16

# Sweep to inspect closely
validation_sweep <- 3

# Spike detection parameters
baseline_time_limit <- 0.5
spike_amplitude_threshold <- 25
derivative_quantile <- 0.99
refractory_period <- 0.002

# Spike waveform window
pre_ms <- 3
post_ms <- 3

# Plotting windows
validation_start <- 1.75
validation_end <- 4
stimulus_start <- 2
stimulus_end <- 3


# ============================================================
# FILE INFORMATION
# ============================================================

current_date <- Sys.Date()

data_filename <- extract_filename(data_file)

file_prefix <- paste(
  current_date,
  data_filename,
  paste0("E", experiment_number),
  paste0("S", series_number),
  sep = "_"
)

message("Analyzing: ", data_filename)


# ============================================================
# IMPORT RECORDING
# ============================================================

recording <- ImportPRecording(
  data_file,
  experiment = experiment_number,
  series = series_number,
  traces = 1,
  encoding = getOption("encoding"),
  filetype = "PatchMaster",
  verbose = TRUE
)

timepoints <- recording@TimeTrace

current_data_pA <- recording@Data[["Imon-1"]] * 1e12

colnames(current_data_pA) <- as.numeric(
  gsub("s|:", "", colnames(current_data_pA))
)


# ============================================================
# FORMAT SWEEPS AND DETECT SPIKES
# ============================================================

sweeps_data <- as.data.frame(current_data_pA) %>%
  mutate(Time = timepoints) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Time,
    names_to = "Sweep",
    values_to = "Current"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Sweep, Time) %>%
  group_by(Sweep) %>%
  mutate(

    # Baseline
    Baseline = mean(
      Current[Time < baseline_time_limit],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    # Baseline-subtracted current
    Current_above_baseline = Current - Baseline,

    # Derivative
    Current_derivative =
      c(NA, diff(Current_above_baseline)) /
      c(NA, diff(Time)),

    # Sweep-specific derivative threshold
    Threshold = quantile(
      Current_derivative,
      derivative_quantile,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    # Initial spike detection
    Is_spike =
      Current_derivative > Threshold &
      Current_above_baseline > spike_amplitude_threshold,

    Spike_time = if_else(
      Is_spike,
      Time,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%

  # Carry last detected spike time down
  fill(Spike_time, .direction = "down") %>%

  mutate(
    Previous_spike_time = lag(Spike_time),

    Time_since_last_spike =
      Time - Previous_spike_time,

    # Apply refractory period
    Valid_spike =
      Is_spike &
      (
        is.na(Previous_spike_time) |
        Time_since_last_spike >= refractory_period
      ),

    Is_spike = Valid_spike
  ) %>%

  select(
    -Spike_time,
    -Previous_spike_time,
    -Time_since_last_spike,
    -Valid_spike,
    -Threshold
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# ============================================================
# PLOT 1: ALL SWEEPS
# ============================================================

all_sweeps_plot <- ggplot(
  sweeps_data,
  aes(x = Time, y = Current)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~Sweep,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(2, 4)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Individual Sweeps",
    x = "Time (s)",
    y = "Current (pA)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

all_sweeps_plot


# ============================================================
# PLOT 2: SINGLE VALIDATION SWEEP WITH STIMULUS
# ============================================================

single_sweep_id <- unique(sweeps_data$Sweep)[validation_sweep]

single_sweep_data <- sweeps_data %>%
  filter(
    Sweep == single_sweep_id,
    between(
      Time,
      validation_start,
      validation_end
    )
  )

y_max <- max(
  single_sweep_data$Current,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

y_min <- min(
  single_sweep_data$Current,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

y_range <- y_max - y_min

bar_ymin <- y_max + 0.05 * y_range
bar_ymax <- y_max + 0.10 * y_range

single_sweep_plot <- ggplot(
  single_sweep_data,
  aes(x = Time, y = Current)
) +
  geom_line(
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = stimulus_start,
    xmax = stimulus_end,
    ymin = bar_ymin,
    ymax = bar_ymax,
    fill = "black"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(
      validation_start,
      validation_end
    ),
    ylim = c(
      y_min,
      bar_ymax
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste(
      "Raw Trace for Sweep",
      single_sweep_id
    ),
    x = "Time (s)",
    y = "Current (pA)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

single_sweep_plot


# Save single sweep
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    save_dir,
    paste0(
      file_prefix,
      "_raw_sweep_",
      single_sweep_id,
      ".svg"
    )
  ),
  plot = single_sweep_plot,
  width = 6,
  height = 4,
  units = "in"
)


# ============================================================
# PLOT 3: OVERLAY OF ALL SWEEPS
# ============================================================

overlay_plot <- ggplot(
  sweeps_data,
  aes(
    x = Time,
    y = Current,
    color = as.factor(Sweep)
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.3) +
  labs(
    title = "Overlay of All Sweeps",
    x = "Time (s)",
    y = "Current (pA)",
    color = "Sweep"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

overlay_plot


# ============================================================
# PLOT 4: ONE SWEEP WITH DETECTED SPIKES
# ============================================================

first_sweep <- unique(sweeps_data$Sweep)[1]

single_spike_plot <- ggplot(
  sweeps_data %>%
    filter(Sweep == first_sweep),
  aes(x = Time, y = Current)
) +
  geom_line(
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = sweeps_data %>%
      filter(
        Sweep == first_sweep,
        Is_spike
      ),
    color = "red",
    size = 2
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste(
      "Sweep",
      first_sweep,
      "with Detected Spikes"
    ),
    x = "Time (s)",
    y = "Current (pA)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

single_spike_plot


# ============================================================
# PLOT 5: ALL SWEEPS WITH DETECTED SPIKES
# ============================================================

stacked_spike_plot <- ggplot(
  sweeps_data,
  aes(x = Time, y = Current)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(
    data = sweeps_data %>%
      filter(Is_spike),
    color = "red",
    size = 0.5
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~Sweep,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Individual Sweeps with Detected Spikes",
    x = "Time (s)",
    y = "Current (pA)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

stacked_spike_plot


# ============================================================
# EXTRACT SPIKE WAVEFORMS
# ============================================================

spike_data <- sweeps_data %>%
  filter(Is_spike) %>%
  transmute(
    Sweep,
    Spike_Time = Time
  )

spike_segments <- lapply(
  seq_len(nrow(spike_data)),
  function(idx) {

    central_time <- spike_data$Spike_Time[idx]
    sweep_id <- spike_data$Sweep[idx]

    sweeps_data %>%
      filter(
        Sweep == sweep_id,
        between(
          Time,
          central_time - pre_ms / 1000,
          central_time + post_ms / 1000
        )
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Time_relative = Time - central_time,
        Spike_ID = idx
      )
  }
) %>%
  bind_rows()


# ============================================================
# PLOT 6: SPIKE WAVEFORMS
# ============================================================

spike_waveform_plot <- ggplot(
  spike_segments,
  aes(
    x = Time_relative * 1000,
    y = Current,
    group = Spike_ID
  )
) +
  geom_line(
    alpha = 0.3,
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    aes(group = 1),
    fun = mean,
    geom = "line",
    color = "red",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Detected Spike Waveforms",
    x = "Time around detected spike (ms)",
    y = "Current (pA)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

spike_waveform_plot


# ============================================================
# COMBINE VALIDATION PLOTS
# ============================================================

detected_spikes_plot <- grid.arrange(
  single_spike_plot,
  overlay_plot,
  stacked_spike_plot,
  spike_waveform_plot,
  ncol = 1
)


# ============================================================
# SAVE COMBINED VALIDATION FIGURE
# ============================================================

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    save_dir,
    paste0(
      file_prefix,
      "_detected_spikes.png"
    )
  ),
  plot = detected_spikes_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 15,
  dpi = 300
)

message(
  "Validation plots saved to: ",
  save_dir
)
```
